Step.Name: check stored procedures exists
Step.Script: SELECT COUNT(0) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = CURRENT_SCHEMA() AND TABLE_NAME = '${Company}_SYS_SP_GET_USER_MODULES';

Step.Name: create stored procedures
Step.Script: CREATE VIEW "${Company}_SYS_SP_GET_USER_MODULES" AS SELECT A.*, A."PlatformId" AS "Platform", B."Code" AS "UserCode" FROM ( SELECT "ModuleId", "PlatformId", "ModuleName", "ModuleCategory", "ModuleEntry", "Activated", 'A' AS "AuthValue" FROM "${Company}_SYS_MODULE" WHERE "PlatformId" <> 'COMBINATION' AND "Activated" = 'Y' UNION SELECT "ModuleId", 'DESKTOP' AS "PlatformId", "ModuleName", "ModuleCategory", "ModuleEntry", "Activated", 'A' AS "AuthValue" FROM "${Company}_SYS_MODULE" WHERE "PlatformId" = 'COMBINATION' AND "Activated" = 'Y' UNION SELECT "ModuleId", 'TABLET' AS "PlatformId", "ModuleName", "ModuleCategory", "ModuleEntry", "Activated", 'A' AS "AuthValue" FROM "${Company}_SYS_MODULE" WHERE "PlatformId" = 'COMBINATION' AND "Activated" = 'Y' ) A, ( SELECT * FROM "${Company}_SYS_USER" WHERE "Activated" = 'Y' ) B;
